question: Should OpenClaw accept Podman agent sandboxing as a bundled official plugin using the proposed sandbox SDK/API surface, or should it start as an external ClawHub/npm plugin unless a missing core API is identified?
rationale: The existing plugin seam appears sufficient, but the request changes official sandbox posture, plugin configuration, public SDK/API surface, docs, and dependency ownership, which automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Review as bundled backend
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the candidate official Podman backend and require security, dependency, API, docs, and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish a Podman sandbox plugin externally through ClawHub/npm using current seams, then revisit bundling after adoption or an API gap is proven.

options.title: Fold into broader backend planning
options.body: Defer this narrow backend decision to the broader execution-backend/resource-profile discussion in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82017.

recommendation.title: Review as bundled backend
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the candidate official Podman backend and require security, dependency, API, docs, and runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account is the strongest available product-boundary owner from recent sandbox registry, OpenShell backend, and docs history.
